metadata.case_name: WONG SUN CHEONG, SUING BY HIS NEXT FRIEND LEE YIN SHEUNG v. CHOI CHI KONG AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: delivery man at Kai Ming Food Shop

source: P sustained severe head injuries as is borne out by the agreed medical evidence.

injuries.description: fractures on the left side of his skull
source: Radiological investigations showed fractures on the left side of his skull, subarachnoid bleeding, subdural bleeding as well as contusion of the brain substance.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple fractures involving skull or facial bones

In August 2012, he developed status epilepticus with refractory generalized epileptic seizures.

injuries.icd_description: Epilepsy due to injuries to the head

injuries.description: skull defect requiring cranioplasty with a metallic prosthesis
source: In May 2012, he was re‑admitted to QEH for his third operation, a cranioplasty to repair the skull defect with a metallic prosthesis.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of skull or facial bones

manifestations.description: prolonged post‑traumatic amnesia estimated as over one month
cognitive dysfunction (mild to moderate dementia, MMSE 18/30)
impaired ability to express himself (often using the wrong words) and slowed comprehension of terms and instructions
epileptic seizures (one episode of status epilepticus in Aug 2012; maintained on phenytoin; seizure-free since)
impaired balance / truncal ataxia; could not walk heel to toe
right leg mild spasticity with heightened reflexes
able to walk stably but could not walk heel to toe; able to stand with feet together and eyes closed
not employable in any capacity; permanent loss of earning capacity 100%
not capable of managing his own legal and financial affairs and is not fully independent even inside the home

treatments_received: Emergency operation to evacuate blood clots and to insert a ventricular drain (on the day of admission)
Further emergency operation the following day to evacuate more blood clots
Cranioplasty (May 2012) to repair the skull defect with a metallic prosthesis
Intubation and time in the intensive care unit during seizure episode (Aug 2012)
Transfer to Kowloon Hospital for rehabilitation
Follow up by neurosurgeons every 3 months

losses.description: Dysphasia (problem with language), cognitive dysfunction, naming difficulty, impaired expression and understanding of verbal communications.
Not capable of managing his own legal and financial affairs and is not fully independent even inside the home; requires care and attention for the rest of his life.
Not employable in any capacity; permanent loss of earning capacity assessed at 100%.
